resultContract.artifact: Artifact digest and sizeBytes are correctness-build facts, not repeated samples.
resultContract.storage: Full-fidelity local results stay under ignored benchmarks/results and are consumed after a successful update; raw samples are never copied into Git.

bestMetricsContract.storage: Only the current lower-is-better value for each comparable category and metric is stored in this catalog.
bestMetricsContract.rule: Update compares only lower-is-better positive values inside one exact workload, source-equivalence, platform, artifact target, ABI, profile, host, recipe class and policy category; toolchain and recipe may improve that same cell, while correctness outputs never rank.
